analysis_scope: Retrospective exploratory analysis of already-frozen development policies on the original cached held-out outcomes; no policy reselection, fitting or new image inference.
limitations: Unadjusted exploratory 95% percentile intervals, not universal or simultaneous claims. Fixed policies/galleries; excludes fitting, calibration, gallery selection and population shift uncertainty. Zero-event bootstrap intervals cannot bound population FPIR; supplementary identity-level bounds are distinct from scored-probe FPIR.

0.001.limitations: Exploratory unadjusted 95% intervals. Fixed galleries and frozen policies; uncertainty excludes model fitting, threshold estimation, gallery selection and population shift. Common-success analysis describes a selected subset only. Zero-event bootstrap intervals cannot bound population FPIR.
0.001.method: Paired percentile identity bootstrap stratified by role and subgroup; identical identity draws across methods

fpir.interval_warning: The empirical bootstrap cannot generate unobserved events; [0, 0] does not bound population FPIR. The supplementary one-sided bound concerns any false referral per independent identity, not scored-probe FPIR.

zero_event_identity_bound.dependence_model: Independent, exchangeable identities under this fixed gallery and frozen policy; arbitrary dependence among images of one identity. Extraction failures remain unresolved and do not generate a referral.
zero_event_identity_bound.estimand: Probability that an identity has any false referral in its probe set
zero_event_identity_bound.interpretation: For an equal fixed number of intended probes per identity, the false referral rate per intended probe is no greater than the probability of any referral per identity. This implication does not bound FPIR conditional on successful extraction or establish deployment performance.
